jobs.title: Unified MDR 24/7 AI-Native detection & response
jobs.description: Skip to content MDR Powered by AI, Guided by Experts AI + human-led MDR delivering 24/7 threat detection, triage, response, and incident support Get Started Book a Demo Trusted by Leading Partners MDR Transformed The Guardz MDR unifies SentinelOne EDR, ITDR, and other platform detections into one contextual system of normalized incidents, overseen by an elite team of security experts. AI + Human-Led MDR Delivering 24/7 managed detection and response across endpoint and identity threats, by combining real-time detection with expert human intervention to keep MSPs secure, informed, and in control. Get Started Fully Managed SOC Follow the sun coverage by expert threat hunters and analysts with SLA-backed precision. Identity-Centric Incident Management Threats are mapped to users and aggregated into a incident timeline for transparent decision making. Noise Reduction Reduce alert fatigue using AI to enrich data and benchmark activity prior to review by MDR specialists. Automated Response, Playbooks & Reports From isolation to suspension, responses are precise, while playbooks and reports enhance communication. Embedded SentinelOne EDR Embedded with SentinelOne Singularity EDR for enterprise-grade endpoint protection, seamlessly deployed and centrally managed through Guardz with oversight from the MDR team. Behavioral And Static AI Engines Real-time analysis of process behavior, execution chains, and memory operations to detect ransomware, fileless attacks, and zero-day threats without cloud dependency. Automated Response Threat Investigations Policy Management Get Started Cloud ITDR Guardz ITDR continously monitors user behavior and activity in Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, flagging suspicious patterns to prevent account takeover and suspending accounts before any damage occurs. Behavioral Analytics Anomaly detection of cloud identity behavior and posture based on benchmarks that help identify human risk. Context-Rich Correlation Incident Timeline Built-In Use Cases Get Started Detect. Analyze. Respond. Done. Rest well knowing you have full control of your clients’ security while Guardz MDR automates detection and response and brings in expert support when it matters most. Built for MSPs Guardz MDR is specifically designed for MSPs to enhance MTTD and MTTR through the right combination of automation and visibility, addressing industry-wide talent gaps and daily operational challenges. Connect the Dots Threats detected across security controls are native to the Guardz detection and response platform, enabling MDR incidents to correlate findings to identities in ways that other tools may overlook. Automated and Human-Backed AI agents triage and escalate threats in real time, while security analysts step in to guide, contain, and remediate incidents while keeping MSPs and admins involved and informed every step of the way. Threat Hunting and 24/7 SOC Around-the-clock monitoring improves risk and incident management, while expert researchers and threat hunters proactively address evolving cybersecurity threats. How it Works? Alert Triage MDR leverages AI to manage and prioritize alerts, removing the burden of false positives and noise. Incident Analysis MDR offers in-depth incident analysis across security controls for a comprehensive risk overview. Incident Support MDR security experts actively mitigate incidents and engage with MSP admins to provide real-time support. Recognized, Reviewed, Proofed. Guardz is the top choice for MSPs, offering a unified platform powered by AI to streamline cybersecurity and drive growth.
